It is found from the western [[Mediterranean]] to [[Central Asia]] in sandy, well-drained soil, particularly coastal and desert dunes. ==Common names== *{{langx|en|Jaffa groundsel,{{cite web |title=Senecio joppensis, Jaffa Groundsel |url=http://www.flowersinisrael.com/Seneciojoppensis_page.htm |publisher=Flowers in Israel |access-date=2015-05-10}} Buck's horn groundsel{{cite web |title=Senecio glaucus, Senecio desfontainei, Buck's horn groundsel |url=http://www.flowersinisrael.com/Senecioglaucus_page.htm |publisher=Flowers in Israel |access-date=2015-05-10}}}} *{{langx|ar|شيخة رمادية or جرجار or النوير }} ==Distribution and habitat== Found in sandy soils of [[coastal plains]], [[beach|strand]]s, and [[steppe]]s. ;Native to the [[Palearctic]]: :'''Middle East''': [[Afghanistan]], [[Algeria]], Egypt - [[Sinai Peninsula|Sinai]], [[Israel]], [[Iran]], [[Iraq]], [[Jordan]], [[Kuwait]], [[Lebanon]], [[Libya]], [[Morocco]], [[Pakistan]], [[Saudi Arabia]], [[Syria]], [[Tunisia]], Turkey - [[Anatolia]] :'''Macaronesia''': Canary Islands - [[Gran Canaria]], [[Fuerteventura]], [[Gomera]], [[Hierro]], [[Lanzarote]], [[Tenerife]] :'''East Europe''': [[Saratov Oblast]], [[Volgograd Oblast]], [[Astrakhan Oblast]], [[Rostov Oblast]], [[Kalmykiya]] :'''Southeastern Europe''': [[Bulgaria]], [[Crete]], [[Crimea]], [[Greece]], [[Italy]], [[Kosovo]], [[Malta]], [[Montenegro]], [[Serbia]], [[Sicily]] :'''Southwestern Europe''': [[Balearic Islands]], [[France]], [[Portugal]], [[Spain]] :'''Western Asia''': [[Israel]] :'''Caucasus''': [[Republic of Adygea|Adygea]], [[Armenia]], [[Azerbaijan]], [[Chechnya]], [[Republic of Dagestan|Dagestan]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], [[Ingushetia]], [[Kabardino-Balkaria]], [[Karachay–Cherkessia]], [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[North Ossetia–Alania]], [[Stavropol Krai]] :'''Central Asia''': [[Turkmenistan]], [[Uzbekistan]] :'''India''': [[Himachal Pradesh]], [[Jammu]] and [[Kashmir]] ==Subspecies== Three subspecies are accepted. *'''''Senecio glaucus'' subsp.
